Update12 Apr 2026
Homepage structure expanded to support ongoing communication
The staging layout introduces a clean feed area directly on the homepage, giving VAN a place for concise operational updates without forcing visitors into the authenticated app. The goal is faster understanding, stronger narrative continuity, and easier external sharing.
  • New front-page space for product and strategy communication
  • Card hierarchy designed for frequent short-form publishing
  • Keeps public and authenticated surfaces fully separated
Report09 Apr 2026
Placeholder monthly report card for public summary distribution
This block demonstrates how reports can be summarized in a way that is readable on first visit. A future live version could link to a PDF, snapshot, or public metrics page while preserving a short abstract on the homepage itself.
  • Compact summary format for performance narratives
  • Built to sit next to live strategy pages and investor contact flows
  • Visual treatment tuned for screenshot use and mobile reading
News06 Apr 2026
Public-facing content lane prepared for milestones and announcements
Beyond strategy statistics, the homepage can now present milestones such as new reports, investor notes, platform changes, or research highlights. This creates a more complete public surface for VAN without changing the private application workflow.
  • Suitable for release notes, market commentary, and research posts
  • Supports mixed cadence, from quick notices to deeper publications
  • Maintains the current design language and dark visual system
Suggested publishing rhythm
A lightweight cadence keeps the homepage active without turning it into a blog. One short update, one report summary, and one broader note can already make the public side feel materially more alive.
Weekly: short operational or research update
Monthly: performance or process summary
Ad hoc: milestone announcement or product note
Review checklist
Does the headline feel credible and investor-facing?
Is the feed better above or below the current hero concept?
Should reports link out or open inline detail cards?
